LanguageData.Raven_Apparel_AyayaHat.label: (Raven) Tengu Hat
LanguageData.Raven_Apparel_AyayaHat.description: A hat adorned with six white pom-poms. These six pom-poms are said to represent the six fundamental practices of Buddhism: Generosity, Morality, Patience, Diligence, Meditation, and Wisdom. Does Aya really possess all of these?
